items.name: Border Beam Button
items.description: Pill call-to-action with a bright gradient beam that travels around its border at constant speed and accelerates on hover.

items.name: Like Burst Button
items.description: Heart toggle with a ring and particle burst plus an odometer-style rolling like count.

items.name: Magnetic Button
items.description: Circular “Get started” button that is pulled toward the cursor with spring physics and a parallax label.

items.name: Radiant Button
items.description: Gradient-rimmed button whose soft halo and border highlight follow the cursor, orbiting on its own when idle.

items.name: Save Button
items.description: Save button that morphs into a spinner and then a drawn check with a “Saved” label.

items.name: Shimmer Button
items.description: Dark AI action button with a sweeping shimmer highlight, twinkling spark and a springy press that throws off sparkles.

items.name: Elastic Slider
items.description: Volume slider that rubber-bands when dragged past either end, with a floating value bubble.

items.name: Expanding Search
items.description: Search icon that expands into a field with filtered, highlighted suggestions and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: Gooey Switch
items.description: Settings toggles whose thumbs stretch and merge like liquid thanks to an SVG goo filter.

items.name: OTP Input
items.description: Six-digit verification code input with an animated caret, auto-advance, paste support and success/error feedback.

items.name: Stacked Chips
items.description: Selectable filter chips that reflow with smooth FLIP motion while selections stack into a counted summary.

items.name: Theme Toggle
items.description: Sun-to-moon morphing toggle that flips its little stage between light and dark with a circular reveal.

items.name: Dust Text
items.description: Thousands of glowing dust particles assemble into a word and scatter away from the pointer.

items.name: Gradient Wave Text
items.description: A large heading filled with a flowing multi-stop gradient while the letters ride a gentle wave; pointer steers the flow.

items.name: Liquid Chrome Text
items.description: Polished liquid-metal lettering with rippling surface and moving specular reflections that track the pointer.

items.name: Rolling Counter
items.description: An odometer-style revenue KPI where each digit column rolls to its new value with a staggered spring.

items.name: Shimmer Wave Text
items.description: A headline where a soft light wave sweeps across the letters, lifting each one as it passes; follows the pointer on hover.

items.name: Staggered Text
items.description: Rotating hero phrases whose letters enter and exit with a staggered blur-and-rise; click or use arrow keys to advance.

items.name: Typewriter AI Text
items.description: An AI assistant answer that streams in token by token with a glowing gradient caret and soft fade-in.

items.name: Circular Progress
items.description: A gradient ring progress indicator with a glowing end-cap and counting percentage; drag around the ring to scrub.

items.name: Morph Loader
items.description: A soft gradient blob that morphs between circle, rounded square and triangle while it spins.

items.name: Orbiting Dots
items.description: Glowing dots orbit a pulsing core on three tilted rings with depth-sorted perspective; pointer tilts the system.

items.name: Pulse Equalizer
items.description: A voice-assistant listening state with a pulsing gradient mic orb, live equalizer bars and a streaming transcript.

items.name: Skeleton Shimmer
items.description: A social post skeleton with a sweeping shimmer that resolves into real content, then loops; click to toggle.

items.name: Event Ticket
items.description: A boarding-pass style event ticket with notched perforation, a generated barcode and a pointer-reactive holographic sheen.

items.name: Flip Card
items.description: A music album card that springs over in 3D to reveal track details on its back, with a dynamic depth shadow.

items.name: Photo Stack
items.description: A stack of hand-drawn polaroid snapshots that fans out on hover and shuffles the top photo to the back on click.

items.name: Profile Card
items.description: A social profile card with an animated gradient avatar ring, shining verified badge, rolling stats and a stateful follow button.

items.name: Receipt Printer
items.description: A thermal paper receipt with zigzag torn edges that prints out of a slot line by line, totals rolling up at the end.

items.name: Tilt Glare Card
items.description: A metal credit card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with a moving specular glare and parallax depth layers.

items.name: Bouncy Accordion
items.description: An FAQ accordion where panels open with springy overshooting height and chevrons rotate with a bounce.

items.name: Context Menu
items.description: An iOS-style context menu that lifts the pressed item over a blurred backdrop, scales in from the touch point and opens a submenu.

items.name: Fan Menu
items.description: A floating action button that fans out a radial arc of actions with staggered spring physics and labelled hover states.

items.name: Gooey Tabs
items.description: A segmented control whose liquid indicator stretches, splits and re-merges between options using an SVG goo filter.

items.name: Magnifying Dock
items.description: A frosted macOS-style dock whose CSS-drawn app icons magnify under the pointer, bounce on launch and show tooltips.

items.name: Morphing Tab Bar
items.description: A mobile bottom tab bar whose notch and floating active bubble stretch and morph as they travel between tabs.

items.name: Chroma Ring
items.description: A raymarched iridescent torus with travelling light streaks and colour bloom; drag to tilt and fling it into a spin.

items.name: Liquid Metal
items.description: Chrome metaballs rendered in WebGL with environment reflections that merge, drift and follow your cursor; hold to gather them.

items.name: Mesh Gradient Hero
items.description: A silky, slowly flowing mesh gradient with film grain behind a landing-page hero, cycling palettes and bending toward the pointer.

items.name: Nebula Orb
items.description: A glowing WebGL nebula sphere with domain-warped noise, fresnel rim and halo that follows the pointer and pulses on click.

items.name: Voice Wave
items.description: Voice-assistant ribbons of additive sine lobes that react to a scripted transcript; hold anywhere (or Space) to talk.

items.name: 3D Album Carousel
items.description: A CSS 3D ring of album covers with reflections, depth dimming, inertial drag and a now-playing pill that follows the front card.

items.name: Cinematic Carousel
items.description: An infinite film-poster carousel with depth, scale and blur on side cards, ambient colour glow, spring snapping, drag, arrows and autoplay.

items.name: Logo & Quote Marquee
items.description: Two counter-scrolling infinite rows of wordmarks and testimonials with soft edge fades that ease to a stop on hover and can be dragged.

items.name: Activity Rings
items.description: Fitness-style activity rings with overlap past 100%, counting legend values and a week strip that animates between days.

items.name: Revenue Line Chart
items.description: A smooth gradient area chart that draws in, morphs between 1W/1M/3M/1Y ranges and shows a snapped crosshair tooltip on hover.

items.name: Paywall Screen
items.description: A full mobile paywall with glowing app-icon hero, feature list, yearly/monthly plan selector with savings badge, shimmering CTA and legal footer.

items.name: Settings Screen
items.description: An iOS-style settings screen with live search, grouped icon-tile rows, a working Airplane Mode toggle and a large title that collapses on scroll.
